Bid Submission Type.value: Electronic submission via the iSupplier portal; manual hard‑copy sealed envelope also accepted. Fax and email submissions are not accepted.

Term of Bid.value: Three (3) year initial term with two (2) successive one‑year extensions, not to exceed five (5) years total.

Pre Bid Meeting.value: Pre‑bid conference on 2024-06-10 15:00 EDT (virtual Teams); attendance encouraged but not mandatory.

Installation.value: Imaging required (Windows Autopilot, Chrome enrollment); vendor must coordinate deployment schedule with ED TECH and provide white‑glove services (asset decal, reporting, etching, delivery).

Bid Bond Requirement.value: Offerors must comply with any bid bond requirements of the District as noted elsewhere in the solicitation document.

Payment Terms.value: Prime vendors must pay all submitted invoices, including retainage, to subcontractors within 10 days of receiving payment from the district; retainage may not exceed 5% and non‑disputed payments may not be withheld.

Any Additional Documentation Required.value: Certificate of insurance/bond; Form W‑9; Letter of Intent for each M/WBE subcontractor; Factory‑authorized repair and maintenance certifications; Form 1295 certificate of interested parties; M/WBE compliance forms and certifications

MFG for Registration.value: Bidder must be a manufacturer or authorized reseller; factory‑authorized repair and maintenance certifications must be submitted with the proposal.

Contract or Cooperative to use.value: Central Texas Purchasing Alliance (CTPA) interlocal agreement cooperative purchasing arrangement.
